Women’s and men’s health

Gynaecology, urology, endocrinology and cardiology consultations. Preventive examinations and treatment.

A comprehensive approach

At Breoris Medical, we consider women’s and men’s health as a whole, including the connections between hormonal, reproductive, cardiovascular and other body systems.

Our specialists

Gynaecologists, urologists, endocrinologists, cardiologists, physicians and other specialists work together to address symptoms and investigate their causes.

Prevention and treatment

Care ranges from preventive examinations and assessment of age-related changes to treatment and individual health programmes.
